title: Recorded change explanations
responsibility: Summarizes recorded reasons within writing limits while retaining full notes, attempts and outcomes.

inputs.name: boundedText.notes
inputs.description: Notes to normalize, deduplicate and join.

inputs.name: boundedText.limit
inputs.description: Maximum character count and optional word limit for the combined text.

inputs.name: entityReasons.reasons
inputs.description: Recorded explanations with behavior, simplification and performance attempts and outcomes.

inputs.name: reasonsTried.reasons
inputs.description: Prepared reasons whose attempts should be summarized for a history row.

inputs.name: reasonUses.uses
inputs.description: Subject/kind/outcome uses of an attempt to group.

outputs.name: boundedText
outputs.description: Combined normalized text and whether it was cut. Truncation uses whole words and an ellipsis when possible; an overlong first word is cut by Unicode characters.

outputs.name: entityReasons
outputs.description: Bounded behavior and attempt summaries, distinct outcomes and original full notes/attempts grouped by normalized text with subjects. long is true for multiple reasons or any truncation.

outputs.name: reasonsTried
outputs.description: Nonempty attempt summaries for simplification then performance, omitting exact duplicate attempts already represented by simplification.

outputs.name: reasonUses
outputs.type: Array<{ kind: ReasonKind; outcome: string; subjects: string[] }>
outputs.description: Groups by reason kind and outcome, listing their subjects.
